# v0.1.0-demo.1 — DEMO-001 salvaged product path

This pre-release captures the first deliberately product-facing DEMO-001 checkpoint after salvaging the proven demo path to `main`. It is a demo milestone, not a production-readiness claim.

## Highlights

- Hardened the React Product V1 Control Center for the live `Discover → Verify → Rank → Prepare` journey.
- Separated discovery provenance from application authority: BA, StepStone, GuteJobs and similar aggregators remain discovery evidence; operator/application actions require an Employer-Origin vacancy path.
- Added live vacancy freshness and detail-drift handling so stale assessment snapshots are refreshed before evidence review/ranking.
- Added bounded, fail-closed refill/review tooling for capability fit, hard-filter evidence and deterministic ranking without fabricating Product V1 authority.
- Upgraded the Application Workspace from fragment-only output to a downloadable application package: CV DOCX/PDF, letter DOCX/PDF and one-click ZIP.
- Added a canonical local demo server helper and an end-to-end operator smoke for live Employer-Origin links and application-package boundaries.
- Introduced GitHub Release Management with SemVer-compatible tags, curated/generated release notes and a guarded `main`-only publishing workflow.

## Bug fixes

- Removed the Product Truth global `window.fetch` monkeypatch and deduplicated initial Product Truth fetch/parse/normalization work that caused multi-minute frontend startup and blocked interaction.
- Removed the whole-body persistent `MutationObserver` tooltip pass that caused pathological main-thread work.
- Fixed the OpenAI Responses structured-output schema: unsupported `uniqueItems` no longer causes `invalid_json_schema` HTTP 400 failures.
- Replaced a reused 1-cent Origin-prompt cost ceiling with an Application-specific bounded budget so valid document drafts are not discarded solely because the larger application context costs more.
- Added an exportable evidence-first fallback so provider failure no longer produces zero downloadable application files.
- Fixed local demo startup races by waiting for actual HTTP readiness instead of relying on fixed sleeps.
- Prevented aggregator/discovery URLs from being presented as final Product/Application action URLs.
- Added live detail fingerprint checks and audited assessment refresh so changed vacancies cannot silently reuse stale assessment evidence.
- Fixed Data Layers portal mounting after asynchronous Product Truth loading without reintroducing a persistent DOM observer.
- Removed the `BASISLEBENSLAUF` compiler marker from generated CV output and reduced duplicate letter envelope/greeting/closing structure.
- Added ZIP packaging with manifest/checksums for the four application documents.

## Product and operator changes

- Review-scope fit is labeled as role affinity rather than implied authoritative Product fit until a job is actually rankable.
- Job-table headers support stable column sorting.
- Sources are grouped more compactly by operational status.
- BA-style internal identifiers are no longer treated as browser-ready original-job URLs.
- Recommendation-cutoff review is explicit and guarded; rankability and ranking scores are not altered to manufacture a Top-5.

## Operator validation on 2026-09-03

The local demo runtime used private candidate documents and live Employer-Origin HTTP evidence, which are not shipped in this Git release.

- A bounded live scout observed 28 active vacancies out of 30 candidates and found 7 live role/Candidate-Fact matches.
- Six selected vacancies had stale detail fingerprints; the audited assessment refresh updated all six before review.
- Evidence-backed hard-filter review produced 6 rankable jobs in the local runtime without hard-filter override writes.
- The Application Workspace successfully completed a real provider-backed draft smoke after the schema fix.
- Application generation remains `draft_for_review`; no automatic submission or send authority was added.

These are operator proofs for the demo checkpoint, not portable database state.

## Known limitations

- A cold `market sensor → origin resolution → connector → assessment → ranking → application` run is not yet reliable enough to be the sole demo path and is the primary post-demo product-recovery target.
- The repository release does not ship the local PostgreSQL runtime state; current/rankable jobs must always be freshly revalidated.
- Application document layout and copy quality are improved but still require product-quality iteration before calling the output generally submission-ready.
- Employer-Origin coverage is still narrower than discovery coverage; unresolved aggregator discoveries must remain non-actionable.
- No automatic application submission, email send or silent application-state mutation exists in this release.

## Safety and authority boundaries

- Candidate Facts remain the factual authority for candidate claims.
- Exact vacancy evidence remains required for job-specific grounding.
- Base-document text is shared with the provider only during the explicit Generate action to support structure/style adaptation.
- Provider calls do not grant draft approval, submission or Product V1 authority.
- All generated documents remain review drafts.
